quests.title: Fire and Ice

dialogue.t: Thanks for the invitation, Sandrone. This food tastes just like I remember. It really brings back memories.
You're welcome. If you like, we can get together more often when I'm back in Snezhnaya. It'll be just like the old days.
Of course.
Speaking of Snezhnaya, how's everything going on your end?
Her Majesty the Tsaritsa's plans have made some initial progress, but Project Stuzha is proving more difficult to implement than the Mayor anticipated.
Then it appears we'll both be busy from now on.
Though we should still have time to stop for a cup of tea every now and then, or even catch a performance by the Korolevskiy Troupe.
Indeed. Though we should still have time to stop for a cup of tea every now and then, or even catch a performance by the Korolevskiy Troupe.
Is Odette still performing ballet?
Yes. Every time I see her, she seems to keep getting better.
Amazing. I'd love to see her perform again when I'm back.
I find it really quite fascinating. Despite learning her craft under Rosalyne, their temperaments and styles couldn't be more different.
That's not necessarily a bad thing.
True... Rosalyne danced with a fiery passion, whereas Odette is as frosty and opaque as a block of solid ice.
She appears to be carrying a heavy burden.
And yet, when she performs on stage, her movements are so pure, as though her heart were free from even the tiniest of blemishes.
Or perhaps she's sealed such things away where no one will see them.
Perhaps. In the end, isn't that what ice does — freeze over the cracks? But she's not fragile, she's resolute. If anything, I'd say she's dangerous.
At least in that regard, she resembles Rosalyne.
Because she's dangerous?
Because of her resolve.
I suppose you're right. No wonder there are rumors that she's the favorite to inherit the "La Signora" title.
Hah... Once we get to know her better, we could invite her to our tea parties. I hope she won't refuse.
Me too.
It's important to find time to relax now and then.

dialogue.sit: (Let's sit like this for a little while longer.)
I think it's time I started clearing up.

dialogue.t: Very well. I'll see you in Snezhnaya.

quests.description: Go to the Kuuvahki Experimental Design Bureau, place your tea table, and have Sandrone take a seat. Then, prepare to enjoy some tea with Arlecchino…
